_comment: Architectural Purpose: Plugin-scoped Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio manifest.
Discovered automatically by MCP-capable agent hosts (Antigravity / Jetski and Claude Code)
when the google-ads-api-developer-assistant plugin is loaded.
Launches server.py in JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio mode (--mcp) so it never collides with
the HTTP A2A sidecar (sidecar.json on 127.0.0.1:8900), exposing tools for GAQL validation,
Protobuf inspection, AST-verified code generation, conversion diagnostics, and HITL-verified
